name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A toolkit that makes AI coding assistants remember context, work faster, and stay more secure across long coding sessions.
buyer: A power-user developer or small team frustrated with their AI coding assistant forgetting context and wasting time re-explaining the project.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs it to keep long AI-assisted coding sessions consistent across days without re-explaining the codebase.
A dev tools company offers managed setup of this as part of an 'AI coding productivity' onboarding package.
A security-conscious team adopts it for the built-in safeguards around what an AI agent can touch.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid setup/configuration services that tune this for a client team's specific stack and conventions.

steal_this: Package a 'configure your AI coding assistant properly' $150 one-time setup call for solo developers using this as the base config.
